Cine-cog 1.0.0 — Make grand, character-consistent cinematics accessible to everyone from a single prompt.

- Enables generation of widescreen cinematic short films, music videos, brand/launch videos, and more with consistent characters and high production value.
- Automates full production pipeline: script/storyboard, character design, scene creation, animation, sound design, and post-production.
- Integrates with CellCog mothership skill for API/SDK setup.
- Provides recommended prompt structures, cinematic styles, output formats, and chat modes for varied use cases.
- Designed for both creative individuals and brands—epic visual storytelling is now one CellCog request away.
